It is a reminder of the importance of staying steadfast in the face of adversity and hardship, as outlined in the Quran. The Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) said, "And it is the strong belief which is not shaken, and the strong person is not put to flight before breaking the news of his loss, and having his nerve tried with the trying of trials."
